summary: Bootstrap room reopen resets in-flight RDMA counter, causing early abort ACK and cross-request KV overwrite
Queued TransferKVChunk lacks room generation tag, writing stale KV into reopened room or crashing scheduler
Room reopen clears unconsumed abort-ack poison flag, releasing decode pages while prior RDMA write is active
Stale room clear evicts early TransferInfo of next request, causing HTTP 500 or 3-request cross-page write
Non-idempotent CommonKVReceiver._clear() deletes newly allocated room state on cancel-and-reopen
Mismatched heartbeat ID skips lease renewal while decode lacks receive timeout, hanging requests and leaking KV
Under DP > 1, release_memory_occupation refused on a busy rank still releases GPU memory on idle ranks while returning HTTP 400
Weight update checks non-paused state before waiting on writer lock; a concurrent in-place or retract pause freezes readers and deadlocks
Opt-in scheduler checks diverge across TP ranks within a round, desynchronizing collective operations
Paged intake limit (kv_capacity - 1) exceeds empty-pool alignment at page_size > 1, admitting requests that livelock waiting for slots
Zero-RoPE MLA KV buffer writer lacks skip-index guard on padded CUDA graph rows, overwriting reserved slot 0 and causing NaN logits
Calling resume_memory_occupation without prior release raises uncaught KeyError in offload_tags.remove and terminates the scheduler
